exclusions.reason: Sandboxing, distribution provenance, vulnerability gates, accessibility and resource budgets are Inflow release controls rather than a Typora user-capability benchmark.
The document health center is an Inflow differentiation target, not a Typora migration-parity claim.
A shared semantic rendering profile across preview, diagnostics and export is an Inflow differentiation target, not a Typora migration-parity claim.
Inflow's Recovery-isolated local version timeline is a differentiated lifecycle contract and is not claimed as direct Typora parity.
Interactive block-level three-way merge is an Inflow differentiation target, not a Typora migration-parity claim.
Resource governance and previewed structural batch edits are Inflow differentiation targets, not Typora migration-parity claims.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Users can create, open, save, rename, move and manage Markdown documents through the native file and sidebar workflows.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 native document lifecycle with conflict-safe open, save, Save As and external-change handling.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: The View menu exposes a keyboard-accessible source-code mode in addition to Typora's live rendered editing surface.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 exposes explicit source editing, split live preview and preview-only modes with stable shortcuts and first-window defaults.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Built-in themes are selectable from the Themes menu and macOS can use separate light- and dark-mode choices.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 ships deterministic light and dark built-in preview themes with a follow-system choice.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Discoverable preferences control recurring editor behaviors such as word-count visibility and appearance choices.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 provides a typed Settings contract for mode defaults, font size, editor aids, navigation and file-opening behavior.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Keyboard-accessible commands insert or transform headings, lists, tables, code, math, links and inline formatting while standard edit operations remain available.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 source editor offers undo, redo, find, replace and reversible Markdown-format assistance.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Current-document find and replace expose match navigation, case controls and a documented regular-expression path.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 provides literal current-document find/replace with case control; later parity work may add regex only under a PRD requirement and fixture.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: On macOS, spelling and grammar controls use the system editing path and can be enabled or disabled from discoverable menus.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 exposes macOS system spell checking as an independent setting without changing Markdown bytes.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Typora documents an autosave path intended to reduce loss of edits during ordinary document work.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 separates user-file saving from encrypted Recovery and defines named, unnamed, conflict and degraded-protection behavior explicitly.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Markdown links, relative file targets, in-document anchors and outline navigation have discoverable open or jump behavior.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 provides policy-checked local links, exact fragment matching, heading navigation and source/preview position mapping.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Markdown marks are hidden or revealed around the active content while the document remains editable.
capabilities.inflowPath: Reversible instant-rendered editing mode with byte-predictable Markdown and document-scoped undo.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Core GFM writing and reading paths cover headings, emphasis, links, lists, tasks, code, tables, and images.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 source editor and frozen cmark-gfm dialect contract.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Footnotes, TOC, YAML front matter, and GitHub-style alerts have discoverable editing and rendered-reading paths.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 versioned dialect extensions shared by editing, preview, and export.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: When the documented Markdown extension is enabled, text wrapped in double equals signs is rendered as highlighted text.
capabilities.inflowPath: P2 dialect compatibility must provide an explicit, configurable highlight syntax path or publish a dedicated exception before parity can be claimed.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: When the documented Markdown extension is enabled, caret-delimited text is rendered as superscript.
capabilities.inflowPath: P2 dialect compatibility must provide an explicit, configurable superscript syntax path or publish a dedicated exception before parity can be claimed.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: When the documented Markdown extension is enabled, tilde-delimited text is rendered as subscript.
capabilities.inflowPath: P2 dialect compatibility must provide an explicit, configurable subscript syntax path or publish a dedicated exception before parity can be claimed.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Emoji shortcodes have a rendered path with autocomplete, while direct UTF-8 emoji remains ordinary document text.
capabilities.inflowPath: P2 dialect compatibility must define shortcode parsing and export semantics; ordinary UTF-8 emoji remains available independently.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Mermaid fences render supported flow, sequence, class, state, and other diagram families and remain visible in supported exports.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 offline Mermaid renderer with fixed version, budgets, sanitizer, fallback, and export parity.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Inline math and fenced math blocks have rendered writing paths in the documented Markdown dialect.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 renders inline and block math offline under fixed budgets, sanitization and export-parity rules.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Math writing supports documented equation references, numbering modes, optional packages and explicit refresh/error-recovery paths.
capabilities.inflowPath: P2 dialect compatibility owns advanced math numbering, reference and package semantics beyond the P0 inline/block baseline.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Legacy sequence and flow fences render through their documented diagram syntaxes.
capabilities.inflowPath: P2 migration-compatible renderer or a separately published exception; Mermaid fences do not silently stand in for these dialects.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Users can open folders, browse files and outlines, search, quickly open, and perform common file operations.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 workspace window with file tree, tabs, outline, full-text search, quick open, permissions, and conflict handling.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Task-list checkboxes can be toggled directly and update the corresponding Markdown task state.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 clickable task items produce explicit, reversible Markdown edits through the shared document undo model.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Fenced code exposes language selection, syntax coloring, copy actions, line-number and long-line display controls.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 code-fence tools add syntax coloring and explicit code-block interactions without changing source unless the user invokes an edit command.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Tables have direct row, column, alignment and cell-editing controls in the rendered writing surface.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 provides graphical table operations and clickable task items while preserving explicit Markdown edits and undo.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Rich clipboard HTML can be converted into Markdown on paste, with an explicit plain-text or Markdown-source paste path.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 Smart Paste presents a bounded, reviewable conversion path and preserves a plain-text alternative.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: A language identifier on a fenced code block activates syntax highlighting for the rendered code block.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 adds code syntax coloring and bidirectional source/preview synchronization under the shared document version model.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Users can select, drag, paste, and organize images with configurable relative-path behavior.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 image paste, attachment directory, relative references, and previewed resource moves; uploads remain an ecosystem boundary.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Inserted images can be copied, moved, renamed or downloaded through document-aware operations that update their Markdown paths.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 provides previewed attachment copy/move operations with relative-reference updates and a single reversible document edit.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Focus mode deemphasizes non-active content and typewriter mode keeps the active line near a stable viewport position.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 focus and typewriter modes that preserve source, selection, accessibility, and undo behavior.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Document and selection statistics expose words, characters, lines and estimated reading time through a discoverable status path.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 provides word, character, paragraph, selection and reading-time statistics without persisting derived counts into Markdown.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Documented HTML elements can participate in editing and rendered reading where the product permits them.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 versioned structural-tag allowlist with sanitization shared by preview and export.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Some HTML and embedded media paths can load or execute content beyond plain Markdown rendering.
capabilities.inflowPath: Core intentionally excludes arbitrary scripts, iframes, and document-triggered network media; sanitized structural HTML and explicit links are the alternative.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Markdown image sources may refer to remote URLs and have a rendered or user-invoked download path.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 may load remote images only after explicit user opt-in through the versioned URL and image policies; the P0 default remains an offline placeholder.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: The document can be printed or exported as an image, and PDF export exposes paper, margin, theme and page-break controls.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 adds system print, bounded long-image output and enhanced postflighted PDF options.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Typora ships six built-in themes selectable from the Themes menu.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 ships at least six built-in themes and controlled design tokens shared by preview and export, without arbitrary CSS or external resources.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Users can install or modify CSS theme files and related font or image resources.
capabilities.inflowPath: P1 design tokens and P2 ThemePolicy-constrained theme packages with isolated font decoding; unrestricted CSS and network resources remain excluded.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: The current document can be exported to native HTML and PDF paths and to a rendered image path.
capabilities.inflowPath: P0 self-contained HTML and postflighted PDF; long-image and enhanced export options enter later requirement IDs.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: HTML can be exported with or without styles and with an outline, and a successful prior export can be repeated from the document workflow.
capabilities.inflowPath: P2 adds controlled styled or unstyled outline HTML, portable document packaging, repeat export and additional single-document formats.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: With Pandoc installed, users can import and export additional document formats from the editor workflow.
capabilities.inflowPath: A discoverable signed Converter Companion or ecosystem tool handles broad cross-format conversion; Core never probes for or executes Pandoc.

capabilities.expectedBehavior: Configured third-party uploaders can receive local image paths and return remote URLs for selected, bulk or insertion-time upload workflows.
capabilities.inflowPath: Image upload remains a separately installed ecosystem tool; Core accepts the resulting standard URL but never launches arbitrary uploader commands.

exceptions.reason: Arbitrary document scripts, iframes, and implicit network media conflict with the Core offline and content-safety boundary.
exceptions.alternativePath: Use sanitized structural HTML, static local resources admitted by policy, or explicit user-opened external links.
exceptions.userImpact: Interactive embeds and document-triggered remote media do not execute inside the Core preview or export.

exceptions.reason: Unrestricted CSS, imports, URLs, and untrusted fonts would bypass deterministic rendering and resource policy.
exceptions.alternativePath: Use P1 design tokens or a P2 ThemePolicy-constrained theme package whose optional fonts pass isolated decoding.
exceptions.userImpact: Existing Typora CSS themes require conversion to the supported declarative theme format and unsupported rules are reported rather than executed.

exceptions.reason: Broad import, export, CLI, and external executable discovery are outside the single-document Core boundary.
exceptions.alternativePath: Install a separately signed Converter Companion or ecosystem conversion tool with an explicit handoff path.
exceptions.userImpact: DOCX, RTF, ODT, EPUB, and LaTeX conversion is not performed by the Core app but remains available through a separate tool.

exceptions.reason: Passing user file paths to arbitrary uploader applications, scripts or cloud services conflicts with the Core offline and process-trust boundary.
exceptions.alternativePath: Install a separately signed upload or publishing tool, then paste or return its standard URL through an explicit handoff.
exceptions.userImpact: Core does not provide automatic, selected-image or bulk cloud upload; upload requires a separately installed tool and explicit user action.
